    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun t : ℝ => (Real.exp (-t) : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ (z - 1)) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
    Complex.Gamma z = ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
